metadata.title: Hazard vs. Risk in Laundry Detergent: How Exposure Changes What “Toxic” Really Means | Tide
metadata.description: Confused by “toxic detergent” claims? Learn the key difference between hazard and risk, why exposure matters, and how safety scientists evaluate detergent ingredients after washing and rinsing.
